presentation.tagline: Every Claude Code window back after a sudden restart.
presentation.description: Remembers which Claude Code windows are open, and after a sudden restart (a freeze, a forced update, a power cut) reopens each one in its folder, on its conversation, in plain claude or through Baton.

features.title: One command after a sudden restart
features.description: Osiris lists the windows that were open when the computer stopped and reopens the ones you tick, each in a terminal of its own.

features.title: Same conversation, same setup
features.description: Each window resumes its conversation in its folder, with the model, effort and permission mode it had.

features.title: Plain claude or Baton
features.description: Windows Baton started go back through Baton; the others resume in claude under the profile they ran on.
